name: bulk_grep_search
description:
Performs multiple text-based regex searches in a single bulk operation. Each search can have its own specific parameters (query, case sensitivity, include/exclude patterns). This is highly efficient for running several independent searches at once.
Results for each search will be returned, formatted in the style of ripgrep.
Use the include or exclude patterns to filter the search scope by file type or specific paths. To avoid overwhelming output, the results for each individual search are capped at 50 matches.

explanation.description: A single, overarching explanation for why this bulk search operation is being performed and how it contributes to the main goal.

searches.description: A list of search operations to perform in bulk.

query.description: The regex pattern to search for.

case_sensitive.description: Whether this specific search should be case sensitive. Defaults to false if not provided.

include_pattern.description: Glob pattern for files to include for this search (e.g. '*.tf').

exclude_pattern.description: Glob pattern for files to exclude for this search.
